A very special feature in the new importations is the appearance of specimens with a double spot on the flank. Moreover, the lateral spot often also runs up to the dorsal fin. Both features are very unusual for Hemichromis. However, the double spot usually appears only on one side of the body; on the other side there is only one spot. Moreover, if one observes enough specimens, one can find every conceivable transition between these extremes and "regular" H. letourneauxi. Nevertheless it is possible that the new importations represent a species new to science.

The largest specimens are about 8 cm long. Animals with a length of about 4-5 cm are already sexually differentiated. However, one must be aware that these fish will reach a total length of 10-12 cm in home aquaria, perhaps even 15 cm in extraordinarily old and large males.
